name: SFGC (fog-belt Tillinghast, San Francisco)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. San Francisco Golf Club, by Lake Merced in the summer fog belt: cool, lush, slightly blue bentgrass greens and fairways; a deeper, softer rough (F0-F2); big jagged bunkers of pale cream-tan dune sand; grey-green fog water; Monterey cypress, Monterey pine and blue-grey eucalyptus (assets-src/trees_sfgc.py). The course chat's design, 2026-11-13. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
